exhibits.title: Exhibit A — Study Crime Scene Sketch (9:02 PM)
exhibits.html:
• Door & Window: Heavy oak double-door bolted from the inside; cliff window latched inside.
  • The Body: Lord Arthur Vance slumped across his desk blotter. First reached and rolled over by Dr. Julian Mercer (#4) at 9:01 PM.
  • Initial Statement (9:01 PM): As guests rushed in, Dr. Julian Mercer (#4) loudly claimed to see Arthur's "chalk-pale lips" and smell "bitter almonds from the spilled wine."
  • On the Desk: Unsigned New Will; a crystal wine glass; a single poured porcelain cup of chamomile tea (barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM); a broken pocket watch.
  • On the Floor: Shattered glass beside a heavy 5-lb brass counterweight in a pool of spilled liquid.

exhibits.title: Exhibit B — Arthur's Shattered Pocket Watch
exhibits.html:
• Make: Custom Vance Precision Gold Chronometer ("A.V. — Time Never Lies").
  • Condition: Crystal cracked; internal gears jammed from hitting the desk corner.
  • Frozen Time: 8:48 PM (12 minutes before the 9:00 PM blackout).
  • Witness Note: Dr. Julian Mercer (#4) snapped the gold lid shut at 9:01 PM, claiming Arthur's watch "always ran twelve minutes slow."

exhibits.title: Exhibit C — Charred Audit Log ('J.M.')
exhibits.html:
VANCE PRECISION INSTRUMENTS — CONFIDENTIAL AUDIT
ARCHIVE BOX #4 (SLATED FOR RELEASE WITH NEW WILL)
-------------------------------------------------
SUBJECT:   2008 St. Jude's Clinic — Surgical Pump Trial
FINDING:   Patient fatality (Nov 2008); Calibration Log 08-B deliberately FALSIFIED

  • Cylinder Label: Reads "9:00 PM Gala Greeting" — hastily glued over a scratched-out title: "Memoir Draft — Confrontation."
  • Study Re-Inspection (Clear Light): The crystal wine glass on the desk is completely full & untouched; the shattered glass on the floor is a water carafe in clear, odorless liquid (zero wine, zero bitter-almond scent). Desk-blotter impressions confirm Arthur collapsed face-down, facing away from the door until Dr. Julian Mercer (#4) rolled him over.

prologue.label: PROLOGUE — 9:00 PM
prologue.sub: Read aloud (or click Read Aloud) to set the scene at Ravenshollow Manor.
prologue.html:
Welcome to Ravenshollow Manor. Outside, a violent November nor'easter has washed out the wooden bridge to the mainland, and the telephone lines are dead. You are guests of billionaire clockmaker Lord Arthur Vance (72).

At 8:45 PM, Arthur retired alone to his second-floor Study to fetch his New Will, bolting the heavy oak door from the inside. At 8:55 PM, guests in the Grand Hall heard Arthur shouting from upstairs: "You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!"

At 9:00 PM sharp, as the Grand Astronomical Clock struck nine, the backup generator died—plunging the manor into darkness for 15 seconds. A sharp crack and heavy thud echoed from the Study. When the lights returned at 9:01 PM, you broke down the bolted door—and found Arthur Vance dead at his desk.

Dr. Julian Mercer (#4)
"There is no bullet wound. It was poison! The moment the lights came back on at 9:01, I saw Arthur's chalk-pale lips and smelled that unmistakable bitter-almond scent from the spilled wine. He died right around nine."
Clara Sterling (#2)
"Wait a moment—when I stepped beside the desk, I noticed Arthur's pocket watch had smashed on the corner—its hands were stopped at 8:48."
Dr. Julian Mercer (#4)
"Ah, yes, I closed the lid so it wouldn't upset everyone. Arthur's watch always ran twelve minutes slow—he told me so himself just yesterday."
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"Slow or not, the New Will is still on his desk—unsigned. Whoever wanted Arthur dead before 9:00 PM is standing in this room."

revealHtml:
The Truth Behind the Last Chime (RV-7146)

The Killer: Dr. Julian Mercer (#4)
The Accomplices (Shadow Team): Jasper Moore (#6), Alistair Finch (#20)
The Inspector: Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)

Arthur Vance did not die at 9:00 PM. He died at 8:48 PM—alone behind a bolted door—from concentrated Aconite hidden in the nightly 8:45 PM sealed amber Heart Tonic vial handed to him by Dr. Julian Mercer (#4) at 8:42 PM. At 9:01 PM, Dr. Julian Mercer rushed to the desk first, pocketing the nightly 8:45 PM sealed amber Heart Tonic vial and later ditching a botanical-smudged handkerchief down the upstairs laundry chute.

Victor Vance (#5) spiked the red wine with harmless sleeping powder, which Arthur never touched. The 8:55 PM argument was a pre-recorded brass wax cylinder played by the Chronos Automaton, and the 9:00 PM crash was the counterweight smashing the water carafe while blackmailed accomplice Jasper Moore (#6) cut the generator breaker for 15 seconds.

The 4-Pillar Proof: (1) Arthur's pocket watch froze at 8:48 PM and his Horologist Journal proves it never lost a second; (2) The wine was untouched and Arthur died of odorless Aconite from the nightly 8:45 PM sealed amber Heart Tonic vial; (3) Dr. Julian Mercer slipped up in Act I by claiming to see Arthur's pale lips (Arthur was face-down!) and smell bitter almonds from spilled wine (it was odorless water!); (4) Exhibit C's charred "J.M." matches both Dr. Julian Mercer and Jasper Moore, but Exhibit E clears Jasper Moore (no 2008 access) and ties Dr. Julian Mercer directly to 2008 St. Jude's Clinic — Surgical Pump Trial — Chief Resident, St. Jude's Clinic (2006–2008); retained 2009!
